cases.label: HA1 Record a delivered report
cases.action: Record the delivery date and Google Doc link of a 40-page reading that has already passed acceptance, publication and QA, in the run log and on the client's Notion page; nothing later depends on this step.
cases.source: hd-v1 acceptance text and rung expectation, unchanged

cases.label: HA2 Two named one-line fixes
cases.action: Correct one misspelled gate name and one wrong table caption in an accepted 40-page reading, each named by section and line; the deterministic mechanical and structure checks re-run before the report is republished.
cases.source: hd-v1 acceptance text and rung expectation, unchanged

cases.label: HA3 Repair four named defects
cases.action: Repair a 40-page reading written on the accepted template against four defects named at acceptance, each with its section, the failed requirement and the evidence; acceptance re-runs every check before the report can be published, and a QA pass follows.
cases.source: hd-v1 acceptance text and rung expectation, unchanged

cases.label: HA4 First parent-child composite
cases.action: Write the first parent-child composite reading produced on this platform, for paying clients, from a complete packet: both charts, the relationship ledger, a long prompt, a new template version and reference works read passage by passage; later parent-child reports will copy its structure, and the acceptance checks test mechanics and structure, not the interpretation.
cases.source: hd-v1 acceptance text and rung expectation, unchanged

cases.label: HA5 Claim audit of the first six reports
cases.action: Before the first production reports produced on this platform reach clients, check every claim in six 40-page readings against their chart data and the cited reference passages, section by section; any single reader would miss claims spread across 240 pages.
cases.source: hd-v1 acceptance text and rung expectation, unchanged

cases.label: HA6 Standard single-person reading
cases.action: Write a standard 40-page single-person reading for a new client from a complete packet on the accepted template, a report type already produced here many times; acceptance checks and a QA pass follow.
cases.source: hd-v1 acceptance text and rung expectation, unchanged

cases.label: HA7 Check a run folder against the naming plan
cases.action: Check that each of the twelve output files of a finished run is present in the run folder and named by the run plan's convention, and list any that are missing or misnamed; nothing is changed.

cases.label: HA8 Handover note from open run items
cases.action: Draft the internal handover note for the next controller session from the open items in the run log: which reports await repair, which await QA and which inputs are still missing; the next controller checks the note against the log.

jobs_note: J0 to J6 (jobs-hd-v1.json, unchanged) are re-read and reported against hd-v1, not gated.

gates.cases: All 8 cases meet every stated expectation (rung in the set; model in the set where stated), as hd-v1 required 6 of 6; HA7 must read Haiku 5.5.
gates.overall: hd-v3 is accepted when all 8 pass on run 1. If any fails, one revision (hd-v3.1) is allowed, run on the same cases and marked as fitted to them; if it also fails, Nathan decides. Run 2 of the cases is reported, not gated.
